questions.stem: A 3 year old boy has a history of progressive developmental delay, ataxia, seizures and in appropriate laughter since infancy. The child has a normal karyotype of 46XY but DNA analysis shows that he has inherited both of his number 15 chromosomes from his father. These findings are most likely to be indicative of which of the following genetic mechanisms?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) GENOMIC IMPRINTING DISORDER Child has features of angelman syndrome and DNA analysis shows uniparental disomy

questions.stem: Cowden syndrome is associated with which of the following genes-

questions.stem: True about healing are all except –

options.label: C
options.text: Platelets are first cell of wound healing

questions.solutionHtml:
Correct Answer (B)

  • Epithelial regeneration starts within 24-48 hrs and will be completed by 5th day 
  • IMPORTANT LANDMARKS IN HEALING -
  • clot formation < 24 hrs

  • granulation tissue – 3-5 days ( maximal by 5 days)

questions.stem: A child is diagnosed to have an anemia which is commonly inherited. There is no history of any such disease in any of the family members of either parent including themselves. What is the % risk of next child to be born with same disease?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) If there is no history of genetic disease in family but child has a genetic disease means it is mostly autosomal recessive and both the parents are carriers, thus 25% is the right answer.

questions.stem: In iron excess condition Protein, A is secreted by liver which causes down regulation protein B in the gut. Protein A and B are respectively?

questions.stem: A 35-year male presents with high grade fever, no lymphadenopathy. A bone marrow examination shows dysplasia in myeloid (neutrophilic lineage) and similar blasts of 12%. A cytogenetics shows the blasts are carrying a translocation (8;21). What is the likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) Although the blast percentage is only 12, the diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia is based on the cytogenetics t(8;21). other cytogenetics which are diagnostic of AML are t [15; 17] and in- version 16.
Correct Answer (A) Burkitt lymphoma – t(8;14) follicular lymphoma – t(14;18) mantle cell lymphoma- t(11;14) Anaplastic large cell lymphoma- t(2;5)

questions.stem: Which factor deficiency will not affect coagulation invivo but will affect invitro?

questions.stemHtml: The following is a picture of liver biopsy with hemochromatosis. What stain is used below to demonstrate the finding ?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Hemochromatosis is excess of iron ( in the form of hemosiderin) accumulated in organs which can be demonstrated by Perls Prussian blue stain

questions.stem: Which of the following arachidonic acid metabolites is anti inflammatory in nature ?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) Lipoxins are also generated from AA by the lipoxygenase pathway, but unlike prostaglandins and leukotrienes, the lipoxins suppress inflammation by inhibiting the recruitment of leukocytes. They inhibit neutrophil chemotaxis and adhesion to endothelium.

questions.stem: Most important adhesion molecule for diapedesis is-
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) PECAM / CD31 is most important adhesion molecule for diapedesis

questions.stem: A 35-year man presents with easy fatigability. Routine blood investigation showed TLC 22,000, Hb 10g/dl, platelets 1lakhs. Differential count showed a 5% blasts, 22% basophils, 8% monocytes. Bone marrow examination shows blasts of 12% which had abundant cytoplasm and granules. Karyotype of the blasts shows t(9;22). What is likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) CML-Accelerated Phase. There is t(9;22) – Philadelphia chromosome so diagnosis is CML, blasts 12% and basophils 22% makes it accelerated phase.

questions.stemHtml: A 2-year child presents with hepatosplenomegaly, lymphadenopathy and lytic lesions in skull. A biopsy from lesion was performed and EM image is as given below. Which of the following is likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) Langerhan cell histiocytosis. Tennis raquet shaped inclusions are characteristic of LCH

questions.stemHtml: A 10 year old boy had a cut in his forearm 4 days ago. Now the bleeding has been stopped due to granulation tissue formation. While taking a skin biopsy a part of the granulation tissue was also included in the specimen. The histology of granulation tissue is shown below. Which type of collagen is found in the granulation tissue ?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) TYPE 3 The early granulation tissue has type 3 collagen predominantly Scar has type 1 collagen

questions.stem: A patient diagnosed of Acute Myeloid leukemia now presents with epistaxis, multiple ecchymotic patches. Coagulation profile of the patient shows elevated BT, CT, PT, aPTT and TT. Which of the following cytogenetic changes are expected in blasts?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (D) t (15;17). AML patient is having DIC, frequently seen with AML M3/Promyelocytic leukaemia, which shows 15;17 translocation.
